title: Bedrock Fish Spawn Eggs
description: This resource-pack adds unused Bedrock Edition spawn eggs for fish.
body:
# Bedrock Fish Spawn Eggs This texture-pack aims to remake the unused Fish Spawn Eggs from Bedrock _**beta 1.2.14.2!**_ While Vanilla Fish Spawn Eggs look... different, these unused textures were textured after Fish Roe.
> "**Roe, is the fully ripe internal egg masses in the ovaries, or the released external egg masses, of fish and certain marine animals such as shrimp, scallop, sea urchins and squid. As a seafood, roe is used both as a cooked ingredient in many dishes, and as a raw ingredient for delicacies such as caviar.**" - [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roe) --- ![showcase of all the updated spawn eggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da135257e34e3a4b433ccf212dcbc711ae515411.png) --- ## Modified Items: - **Cod Spawn Egg** - **Salmon Spawn Egg** - **Pufferfish Spawn Egg** - **Tropical Fish Spawn Egg**
